evidence_refs: PRIMARY SOURCE READ DIRECTLY: Misner, Thorne & Wheeler, Gravitation (W. H. Freeman, 1973), full text via https://archive.org/details/gravitation-charles-w.-misner-kip-s.-thorne-john-archibald-wheeler . Sections read in full rather than summarised: 43.4 'Fluctuations in Geometry' pp. 1190-1195, and 44.2-44.3 pp. 1200-1203. Every equation and page number in the cell is a citation from that read: Lamb-Retherford mechanism (Fig. 43.3, p. 1190), oscillator ground state (43.23-43.24), field ground-state functional (43.25-43.26), field fluctuation scaling dB ~ (hc)^0.5 / L^2 (43.27), metric/derivative/curvature fluctuations (43.29-43.31), Planck length 1.6e-33 cm (43.32), everyday and nuclear-scale magnitudes (43.34-43.35), charge as flux trapped in multiply-connected topology (Fig. 44.1 caption, p. 1200), vacuum field-fluctuation density 1e94 g/cm3 vs nuclear 1e14 (p. 1202, quoting Wheeler 1962).

PROMPTING SOURCE: 'Zero Point Energy: We've Had It All Along!' — The Randall Carlson, published 2026-07-30, interviewing Moray B. King, Ph.D. https://youtu.be/Xht7Yl4cqO0 . Full auto-caption transcript read (701 segments, ~76k characters after timestamp strip). Textbook named by the guest at 6:47.

PEER-REVIEWED SUPPORT, LANE-CORRECTED: Cole & Puthoff, 'Extracting energy and heat from the vacuum', Phys. Rev. E 48, 1562 (1993) — https://journals.aps.org/pre/abstract/10.1103/PhysRevE.48.1562 . Recorded as TEXTBOOK (peer-reviewed theoretical analysis), not MEASURED: it reports no experiment.

COUNTER-EVIDENCE HELD IN THE SAME CELL: the cosmological constant problem — the Planck-cutoff vacuum density fails to gravitate by roughly 120 orders of magnitude, which is the strongest reason the 1e94 g/cm3 figure cannot be read as an extractable reservoir. Named as the chain's largest unaddressed gap.

MEASUREMENT CAVEAT RECORDED HONESTLY: Lamoreaux (1997) Casimir measurement, Phys. Rev. Lett. 78, 5 — existence of the force conclusively demonstrated, but the initial ~5% agreement claim required substantial correction (finite-conductivity corrections 22% gold / 11% copper, two errors flagged by the author). The cell states the correction rather than the headline figure.

REVIEW FINDINGS ACCEPTED (PR #3982, chatgpt-codex-connector): three threads, all engaged rather than waved off. (1) P1 — no commit-evidence record: this file. (2) P2 — Cole & Puthoff mislabelled MEASURED while the cell's own lane table defines that lane as reproduced experiment: relabelled TEXTBOOK with an explicit lane sentence. (3) P2 — the Planck-to-virtual-pair bridge presented as 'a real feature of the standard picture': corrected to King's inference, with the reason it fails stated (virtual pairs are perturbative internal states at the Compton scale; QED does not derive them from Planck-scale geometric fluctuations). Finding 3 was a genuine instance of the exact error the cell exists to name, committed inside the cell itself.
